text_description: The look pairs a relaxed black knit top with narrow red horizontal stripes across the torso and sleeves, its hem sitting loosely at the waist above a voluminous cream-white midi skirt. The skirt is the visual focus: high-waisted with a soft, gathered A-line shape, falling to mid-calf and moving outward in wide panels printed or appliquéd with bold black abstract vertical motifs that resemble irregular brushstrokes or cutout-like forms. Near the lower skirt, a dense layered fringe trim creates a textured, swinging border, with cream fringe above and longer black fringe visible underneath around the hem. One hand is slipped into a side pocket or pocket-like opening at the skirt, and gold-toned bracelets or a watch are visible at the wrist. The styling is finished with dark red/burgundy thong-style heeled sandals, leaving the feet mostly bare, giving the outfit a graphic, resort-like mood with strong contrast between the striped knit top and the tactile fringed skirt.
